segments.text: Calibrate the red spot position for the welding head.
segments.zh: 校准焊接头的红点位置。

segments.text: Calibrate the left or right offset.
segments.zh: 校准左右偏移。

segments.text: If you use the pre-installed welding nozzle for laser welding,
segments.zh: 如果你使用预装的焊接喷嘴进行激光焊接，

segments.text: perform a left or right offset calibration
segments.zh: 就要进行左右偏移校准，

segments.text: when the laser spot deviates left or right from the wire,
segments.zh: 当激光光斑向焊丝左侧或右侧偏离时，

segments.text: despite proper nozzle installation.
segments.zh: 尽管喷嘴安装正确。

segments.text: On the touch screen of the main unit,
segments.zh: 在主机的触摸屏上，

segments.text: tap System Settings, Machine Settings,
segments.zh: 点击“系统设置”、“机器设置”，

segments.text: Enter Administrator Settings.
segments.zh: 进入“管理员设置”。

segments.text: Then input the eight-digit password, 8888888.
segments.zh: 然后输入 8 位密码 8888888。

segments.text: To the right of red spot position offset, tap Start.
segments.zh: 在“红点位置偏移”右侧，点击“开始”。

segments.text: Then tap the left arrow to decrease the offset
segments.zh: 然后点击左箭头减小偏移量，

segments.text: and move the red spot leftward.
segments.zh: 使红点向左移动。

segments.text: Tap the right arrow to increase the offset
segments.zh: 点击右箭头增大偏移量，

segments.text: and move the red spot rightward.
segments.zh: 使红点向右移动。

segments.text: When the center of the red spot falls at the welding wire,
segments.zh: 当红点的中心落在焊丝上时，

segments.text: tap Completed.
segments.zh: 点击“完成”。

segments.text: Calibrate the up or down offset.
segments.zh: 校准上下偏移。

segments.text: When a cutting nozzle is used,
segments.zh: 使用切割喷嘴时，

segments.text: the laser beam may strike the nozzle's inner wall,
segments.zh: 激光束可能会打到喷嘴内壁上，

segments.text: resulting in either blockage or reflection.
segments.zh: 导致遮挡或反射。

segments.text: In such cases, perform left or right offset calibration.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，进行左右偏移校准。

segments.text: If the problem persists,
segments.zh: 如果问题仍然存在，

segments.text: reset the red spot position offset to zero
segments.zh: 把红点位置偏移重置为零，

segments.text: and try calibrating the up or down offset.
segments.zh: 再尝试校准上下偏移。

segments.text: Welding and cleaning nozzles have larger apertures
segments.zh: 焊接喷嘴和清洗喷嘴的孔径较大，

segments.text: and typically do not require such adjustment.
segments.zh: 通常不需要这种调整。

segments.text: Insert the hex key into hole one or hole two
segments.zh: 把内六角扳手插入 1 号孔或 2 号孔，

segments.text: and slowly turn the screw
segments.zh: 慢慢转动螺丝，

segments.text: while observing the light emitting from the nozzle.
segments.zh: 同时观察喷嘴射出的光。

segments.text: If a clear red spot appears, stop turning the screw.
segments.zh: 如果出现清晰的红点，就停止转动螺丝。
